classification: Third separate disclosed integration proposal; v1 and support-aware remain immutable failures.
physical_rule: Payload weight is a continuous known physical parameter. If weight exceeds the frozen table-normal resolution, require the prior valid >=half arm-support ownership. If weight is at or below resolution, support fraction is mathematically unresolvable: require closed grip and measured admissible table normal no greater than that resolution. Invalid or nonfinite signals produce no optional event. C1 is never muted.

resolution_fit.rule_fixed_before_fit: resolution_N = maximum finite positive observed table-normal estimate over the entire gripped normal trajectory + 0.50 N sensor reserve

candidate.unresolved_branch: payload_weight_N <= resolution_N and table_allowed implies max(0, table_wrench_z) <= resolution_N
candidate.arbitration: v1 source ownership, onset persistence and rearm; optional acquisition only, incumbent always preserved

prepositive_gate: All six separated G4 audit normals exactly match C1 before challenged outputs.
challenged_order: authentic official 29x2, require >=17/24 and no control/false regression
known tool-high/lateral/low plus preregistered 25/35 mm true-tool offsets, exact C1 rises/tool/physics
frozen signed X/Y/Z and two-impulse panel plus C1 post-release behavior
only then near-zero panel fixed below
falsifier: Stop without another alternative for any prepositive normal change, official <17/24, new rise/tool/duplicate, inherited loss >5 ms, changed physics/control, or near-zero false/counterexample.
limits: not default, hardware, deployment or safety evidence
